notes.title: Paradise Lust 2 is now available!
notes.content:
[b]Paradise Lust 2 is now fully released!![/b]

Well. That’s it. We’ve officially finished the game.

After two years of development, Paradise Lust 2 is officially out of Early Access and fully launched. The final update is live, the last main storylines are wrapped, and if you’ve been waiting for the whole thing to be finished before jumping in, now’s the time.

This is the one you’ve been waiting for!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44130595/cd0e68d239cb9fd2899bb192edc93fcddbd535d8.gif[/img]

It's been an amazing ride, starting in May 2023, with the game's main storyline coming together in May 2025. A huge thanks to all the beta-testers, supporters and fans who reported issues, posted blooper pics and kept us all smiling as we made the game!

A special shout out to the [url=https://discord.gg/Tsy5znC]amazing Discord community[/url]; if you want to talk about everything from desired content, behind the scenes updates and fun memes, [url=https://discord.gg/Tsy5znC]come join us[/url]!

We appreciate all of you. Seriously!! Mad props to you all.

[u][b]What’s in the last Storyline update?[/b][/u]

Trouble is brewing in Paradise; Scarlett’s heading back to Eric’s island, but not before setting fire to every bridge on the way out.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44130595/6b9a3d2134591612ef51367a1defecd66b037f4c.jpg[/img]
Ryoko and Emi clash over Emi's career, Mina gets to experience the full brunt of the internet, and Francois gets his just desserts. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44130595/d56398c044c56d41fc2da62b886f2928db406d8d.gif[/img]

[u][b][u]What’s next?[/u][/b][/u]

We’ve got four seasonal content updates planned. One for each season (Summer, Autumn, Winter and Spring). Each is a self-contained story built like a mini-movie produced by the Paradise Lust porn studio, and can be played anywhere in the second half of the game. First up? Cath is playing a dangerous blond suspect in the Noir-inspired Wolf Instinct.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44130595/4eaf2e5286b29180b829c3a2b5a7b01874f600f4.gif[/img]


And after that? [i][b]Paradise Lust 3[/b][/i].

The store page for Paradise Lust 3 is already live. Wishlist it to get the latest updates, and see what happens to Jack and the girls as they return to their roots.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3616780/Paradise_Lust_3/
Thanks to everyone who played the game, supported it, broke it, reported bugs, or just quietly waited for the final update to drop. We’re proud of where it landed.

While you’re here...

If you’re looking for something else from the same development team, Sinners Landing is also live in Early Access! A story-rich Adult RPG with dungeon crawling, card-style battles, and animated romance scenes. Tristan Lamprey's a rogue, a scoundrel and a failed magical apprentice, finding a new life in the frontier town of Sinners Landing!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1816140/Sinners_Landing/

The next update of [b]that[/b] goes live tomorrow, dealing with our Half-Orc Pog, and her epic quest... Forging the Sword.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44130595/cbb143d11a9c529941f62017f7df9534a63dc7cf.gif[/img]
Thanks again for supporting all our games. We’re proud to keep building stories worth sticking with.

See you in the next big one! Come chat with us and other fans on [url=https://discord.com/invite/Tsy5znC]Discord [/url]and [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/FlexibleMediaGames/]Reddit[/url]!

notes.title: Paradise Lust 2 hits full release May 15
notes.content:
After a year or so in Early Access and over a dozen updates, Paradise Lust 2 is finally heading for full release on May 15. 

Mark your calendars. The final update includes completed storylines, new scenes, and the last batch of polish we’ve been holding back to make sure nothing explodes on launch. Sorry for the wait, finishing a game this size while keeping things monthly has been a balancing act, but we wanted to get it right.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44130595/be77ff77185b0874bad40b1b54e2b842aada6da3.gif[/img]

If you’ve been waiting for the whole thing to land before playing, now’s your chance. Everything will be in, start to finish.

We’ll post a full breakdown of what’s in the update closer on launch day. 

And yes! [b]Paradise Lust 3 is already in the works.[/b] In fact, the Steam page just went live.
Big cast, bigger drama, and a certain pageant making a return.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3616780/Paradise_Lust_3/

See you all on May 15. Thank you for your support and the wait!

notes.title: Paradise Lust 2 leaving Early Access soon!
notes.content:
Paradise Lust 2 is almost complete, and will be exiting Early Access in Q2 2025. To prepare for that we'll be soon be raising the price from USD 14.99 to its final USD 19.99 (or local equivalent). 

If you're still on the fence, you've got one last week to pick it up at the Early Access price. If you already own it, nothing changes, you’ll keep getting updates as we finish up for the full release, and free post-launch events.

A huge thank you to everyone who’s been playing and sharing feedback throughout Early Access; it's been invaluable for a little company like ours in fixing bugs, squashing typos and streamlining the entire experience.

A special thanks to the amazing gang on [url=https://discord.gg/Tsy5znC]Discord[/url], who've been playing, laughing and posting memes with us all.

If you’ve been enjoying the game, leaving a review on Steam is one of the best ways to support us. It helps more players discover the game and lets us know what’s working for you.

[b]Other ways to stay involved:[/b]	

[list]

Stay tuned!

notes.title: Early Access Launch of Sinners Landing
notes.content:
What more can we say? [b]SINNERS LANDING IS IN EARLY ACCESS![/b] You can grab a copy now. Or better yet, grab like 10 copies and send them to all your friends! 

YES, there is a release discount: 20%. This will be about as cheap as it's gonna be for a very long time. We WILL be raising the price once it leaves Early Access, so the EA price is already a discount, and the additional 20% is as much as we'll likely be discounting that for quite a while. So... Now is the time. 

We have actually timed our release to coincide with the "Deckbuilders Fest" happening at Steam in a couple days. We're hoping that this will provide additional eyeballs on the game, and more coverage. We'll see how that plays out. 

There will be a LOT more information soon - including an Early Access roadmap for the game and other stuff... But for now, the team is just working on small bugs we found in the final testing process, planning the next content, and celebrating this huge step for all of us. 

THANK YOU SO MUCH for being on this journey with us - and let us all pray to the Seven Goddesses that this launch goes well. 

Praise Flaminia!

notes.title: Sinners Landing Demo is now available!
notes.content:
[b]Description[/b]
Tristan Lamprey is a rogue, a cheat, an aspiring artist, and a failed magical apprentice... And he’s on the run from the dread Archmage Xargoth! The Archmage has vowed to hunt him down and punish him for deflowering his beautiful daughter, Princess Sumita. Luckily for Tristan, he has been magically teleported to the hinterlands of the kingdom: the tiny riverside mining village of Sinners Landing. There he's determined to make a new life for himself, ingratiate himself with the locals, and have a really, really good time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44130595/e52526fe4c3f429afd494749689d94e366bc66e4.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44130595/ad1e572390f1100fb7616d246bf98fb1c649bfdc.jpg[/img]

[b]Development[/b]
Flexible Media started the development of Sinners Landing in 2023. Hints and teasers of the game have been shared to the Paradise Lust community on Discord during early development, and an alpha version of the game is currently available to Flexible Media supporters on Patreons and Subscribestar. The team is updating this build near-monthly, much as they did with Paradise Lust. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44130595/0a6e5e51b86641cc66b5eb08f2d61b9f4fbf6a3e.jpg[/img]

[b]Gameplay[/b]
Sinners Landing is a humorous and sexy 2D Card-Battler/RPG adventure. Playing as Tristan, a rogue magician's apprentice, the player romances the beautiful girls of the village, builds skills and abilities, and uses them to fight through a roguelike-style dungeon using a card-battling mechanic. Each crawl into the dungeon is different, with an ever-expanding world of choices, monsters, and combats.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44130595/85d55325f195a59a0e799f32b43af4fcb04db434.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44130595/333c8e8c76398d694b784adeda9debfa10101389.jpg[/img]

Features
[list]
[*] Fully animated sex scenes with over a dozen different women.
[*] Puzzles and challenging subgames.
[*] Replayable dungeon adventures.
[*] Expanded combat system.
[*] Deckbuilder.
[*] Storybased gameplay.
[/list]
